tagline: Protagonist Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with a validated peptide engineering platform advancing a pipeline of novel, oral peptide therapeutics for inflammation, immunology, hematology, and metabolic diseases.
hero_kpi_rationale: Protagonist Therapeutics focuses on developing innovative drug candidates, including oral peptides, for serious diseases. The success of its clinical programs and submissions for marketing approval are the primary drivers of its valuation.

kpis.name: Pipeline Development
kpis.explanation: Progress in research and development programs for new drug candidates.
kpis.description: The company highlights advancement of its drug candidates: Icotyde (IL-23R, psoriasis), Rusfertide (hepcidin, polycythemia vera), PN-881 (IL-17 antagonist, inflammatory skin diseases), PN-477 (triple agonist GLP-1/GIP/GCG, obesity), PN-458 (dual agonist GLP-1/GIP, obesity), and PN-8047 (oral hepcidin, polycythemia vera).
kpis.signal: Six advanced development programs in key areas: Icotyde, Rusfertide, PN-881, PN-477, PN-458, and PN-8047.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Total amount of cash and liquid investments available.
kpis.description: Cash position, including cash equivalents and marketable securities, increased to $646.0 million at the end of fiscal year 2025, compared to $559.2 million at the end of 2024.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in cash to fund clinical operations and development.

kpis.name: Collaboration Milestone Payments
kpis.explanation: Potential revenues from achieving targets in collaboration agreements with Takeda and JNJ.
kpis.description: The company is eligible to receive up to $630.0 million in future milestone payments from JNJ (development and sales) and up to $975.0 million (if opt-out option is exercised) or $305.0 million (if not exercised) from Takeda for development, regulatory, and sales milestones. Total potential: $975.0 + $630.0 = $1,605.0 million.
kpis.signal: Significant revenue potential linked to the success of JNJ and Takeda partnerships.

kpis.name: Maximum Royalty Rates
kpis.explanation: Maximum percentage of net sales returned to the company under its licensing agreements.
kpis.description: If Protagonist exercises its opt-out option, it could receive royalties of 14% to 29% on global net sales of rusfertide, with 29% for annual net sales above $1.5 billion.
kpis.signal: High royalty potential in case of commercial success and opt-out exercise for Rusfertide.

kpis.name: Regulatory Designations for Rusfertide
kpis.explanation: Special statuses granted by regulatory agencies to accelerate drug development and review.
kpis.description: Rusfertide has received Orphan Drug designation, Fast Track designation, and in August 2025, Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) from the FDA for the treatment of erythrocytosis in patients with polycythemia vera.
kpis.signal: Recognition of rusfertide's significant potential by health authorities for regulatory acceleration.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.67 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.01 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.13 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Icotyde NDA Submission
kpis.explanation: Filing of the marketing authorization application for Icotyde.
kpis.description: Janssen submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) to the FDA in July 2025 and a submission to the EMA in September 2025 for Icotyde (icotrokinra), an oral IL-23R antagonist peptide for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older.
kpis.signal: Key regulatory milestone achieved for a Janssen lead product.

kpis.name: Rusfertide NDA Submission
kpis.explanation: Filing of the marketing authorization application for Rusfertide.
kpis.description: Protagonist and Takeda submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) for rusfertide to the FDA in December 2025 for the treatment of erythrocytosis in patients with polycythemia vera (PV). Rusfertide is an injectable mimetic of the natural hormone hepcidin.
kpis.signal: Major regulatory advancement for a potential polycythemia vera treatment.

kpis.name: Takeda Collaboration Upfront Payment
kpis.explanation: Initial payment received from the collaboration agreement with Takeda for rusfertide.
kpis.description: Protagonist received an upfront payment of $300.0 million in April 2024 under the collaboration agreement with Takeda for rusfertide, including a 50%-50% profit and loss sharing arrangement in the United States.
kpis.signal: Significant upfront funding for the joint development and commercialization of rusfertide.

risks.title: Substantial accumulated losses and uncertain profitability
risks.score_rationale: The risk is at the top of the Risk Factors section, with strong language (accumulated losses of $470.7M). The company depends on future financing, making this an existential risk. Capital category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on variable collaboration payments
risks.score_rationale: An 89% drop in collaboration revenue between 2024 and 2025 is highlighted with precise figures. Revenue is described as 'highly variable,' creating significant cash flow uncertainty.

risks.title: Potential failure of clinical trials or development
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention that regulatory approval is not guaranteed despite costs. Strong language: 'we may never succeed.' Central risk for a biotech.

risks.title: Uncertain accounting estimates affecting financial statements
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail complex judgments on revenue, R&D, and assumptions. Mention of 'possible material differences,' impacting financial statement reliability.

risks.title: Dependence on partners for development and commercialization
risks.score_rationale: Agreements with Takeda and JNJ are central. Loss or modification of a partnership (e.g., opt-out) would have a major impact, as indicated in 2025 revenues.

risks.title: High and increasing R&D costs
risks.score_rationale: R&D is expected to increase with clinical programs. These costs are expensed immediately, contributing to losses. Mention of $159M in 2025, up year-on-year.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PTGX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
